
```{r find cluster markers}

Idents(seurat) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.3"

table(seurat$sample, seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.3)

cl_markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = log(1.2))
  
top2_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top5_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top10_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top50_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 50, order_by = avg_log2FC)

top_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
     arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)

write.csv(top_cl_markers, "Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/top_cl_markers.csv")
write.csv(top50_cl_markers, "Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/top50_cl_markers.csv")

```

#### Name clusters
```{r name clusters}

DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.3"

seurat$celltype <- factor(setNames(c("remodelling microglia", # 0 almost the same as 3; most similar to cl5 from Kracht et al., peaks at GW 13 and 18; CCL4L2, CCL3L1, CCL3, CCL4, FOS, EGR1, C3
                                     "inflammatory microglia", # 1 almost the same as 2; CXCL5, CCL2, CCL13, CCL7, IL7R high (https://jneuroinflammation.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12974-015-0474-6 and https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/jnc.14313)
                                     "resting microglia", # 2 almost the same as 1; F13A1, S100A9, CCL13, MMP9, CCL2, MRC1 high; MRC1 and F13A1 are markers of brain-associated macrophages https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2211124717319034?via%3Dihub
                                     "remodelling microglia", # 3 almsot the same as 0; EGR1 and C3 high, https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fncel.2019.00453/full
                                     "lipid associated microglia", # 4 lipid associated, high in APOC1, ACP5, APOE, TREM2, CHI3L (https://aacrjournals.org/cancerres/article/82/18/3291/709018/Lipid-Associated-Macrophages-Are-Induced-by-Cancer)
                                     "proliferating microglia", # 5 MKI67, TOP2A, HIST1H4C, CENPF high
                                     "neuron", # 6 SOX4, MAP1B, DCX, TUBA1A, TUBB2B high
                                     "proliferating microglia", # 7 MKI67, TOP2A, HIST1H4C, CENPF high
                                     "smooth muscle cell", # 8
                                     "neuron" # 9 SOX4, MAP1B, DCX, TUBA1A, TUBB2B high
                                     ), levels(seurat@active.ident))[seurat@active.ident])
my_levels <- factor(c("remodelling microglia",
                                     "inflammatory microglia", 
                                     "resting microglia",
                                     "lipid associated microglia", 
                                     "proliferating microglia",
                                     "smooth muscle cell", 
                                     "neuron"))

Idents(seurat) <- "celltype"
seurat$celltype <- factor(seurat$celltype, levels = my_levels)

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/umap_by_celltype.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
DimPlot(seurat, reduction = "umap_css", group.by = "celltype",pt.size = 0.5, label=F, cols=rev(rainbow_pastel_cols(7))) & NoAxes()
dev.off()
    
png("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/umap_by_celltype.png", width = 2800, height = 1900, res = 400)
DimPlot(seurat, group.by="celltype", reduction="umap_css", cols = rev(rainbow_pastel_cols(7)), pt.size = 0.4) & NoAxes()
dev.off()

```

```{r stacked violing plot function}

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

## remove the x-axis text and tick 
## plot.margin to adjust the white space between each plot.
## ... pass any arguments to VlnPlot in Seurat
modify_vlnplot<- function(obj, 
feature, 
pt.size = 0,
plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
...) {
p<- VlnPlot(obj, features = feature, pt.size = pt.size, ... )+
ylab(feature) + 
theme(legend.position = "none",
plot.title= element_blank(),
axis.title.x = element_blank(),
axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
axis.title.y = element_text(size = rel(1), angle = 0), 
axis.text.y = element_text(size = rel(1)), 
plot.margin = plot.margin ) 
return(p)
}


## extract the max value of the y axis
extract_max<- function(p){
  ymax<- max(ggplot_build(p)$layout$panel_scales_y[[1]]$range$range)
  return(ceiling(ymax))
}


## main function
StackedVlnPlot<- function(obj, features,
                          pt.size = 0, 
                          plot.margin = unit(c(-0.75, 0, -0.75, 0), "cm"),
                          ...) {
  
  plot_list<- purrr::map(features, function(x) modify_vlnplot(obj = obj,feature = x, ...))
  
  # Add back x-axis title to bottom plot. patchwork is going to support this?
  plot_list[[length(plot_list)]]<- plot_list[[length(plot_list)]] +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_line())
  
  # change the y-axis tick to only max value 
  ymaxs<- purrr::map_dbl(plot_list, extract_max)
  plot_list<- purrr::map2(plot_list, ymaxs, function(x,y) x + 
                            scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(y)) + 
                            expand_limits(y = y))
  
  p<- patchwork::wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 1)
  return(p)
}

```

# Gene ontology

#### EnrichR
DE and EnrichR pathway visualization barplot generation.
```{r DE and EnrichR}

# DEenrichRPlot is a function by Seurat.
# Default, which was used here, is to peform "wilcox" test between a group of cells and another group of cells.
# Here I used some cell types against all other cells. Minimum p-values is 0.05 and the log fold change threshold I used is 0.3.
# Different enrichR databases can be used (list here: https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/#libraries) but I used only the Reactome 2022 for this analysis.
```

# Pseudotemporal ordering

#### Destiny package
```{r subset cells}

# Subset control microglia
seurat_ctrl <- subset(seurat, subset = sample %in% c("MG-d3-ctrl", "MG-d15-ctrl", "MG-d30-ctrl", "MG-d58-ctrl")) %>%
        subset(subset = celltype %in% c("remodelling microglia", "inflammatory microglia", "resting microglia", "lipid associated microglia", "proliferating microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)
VariableFeatures(seurat_ctrl) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat_ctrl), unlist(cc.genes))
seurat_ctrl <- CellCycleScoring(seurat_ctrl,
                                  s.features = cc.genes$s.genes,
                                  g2m.features = cc.genes$g2m.genes,
                                  set.ident = TRUE)
seurat_ctrl <- ScaleData(seurat_ctrl, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
seurat_ctrl <- RunPCA(seurat_ctrl) %>% 
        RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)


# Subset cocultured microglia
seurat_cocul <- subset(seurat, subset = sample %in% c("MG-d3-cocul", "MG-d15-cocul", "MG-d30-cocul", "MG-d58-cocul")) %>%
        subset(subset = celltype %in% c("remodelling microglia", "inflammatory microglia", "resting microglia", "lipid associated microglia", "proliferating microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)
VariableFeatures(seurat_cocul) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat_cocul), unlist(cc.genes))
seurat_cocul <- CellCycleScoring(seurat_cocul,
                                  s.features = cc.genes$s.genes,
                                  g2m.features = cc.genes$g2m.genes,
                                  set.ident = TRUE)
seurat_cocul <- ScaleData(seurat_cocul, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
seurat_cocul <- RunPCA(seurat_cocul) %>% 
        RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)


# Subset all microglia
seurat_mg <- subset(seurat, subset = celltype %in% c("remodelling microglia", "inflammatory microglia", "resting microglia", "lipid associated microglia", "proliferating microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)
VariableFeatures(seurat_mg) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat_mg), unlist(cc.genes))
seurat_mg <- CellCycleScoring(seurat_mg,
                                  s.features = cc.genes$s.genes,
                                  g2m.features = cc.genes$g2m.genes,
                                  set.ident = TRUE)
seurat_mg <- ScaleData(seurat_mg, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
seurat_mg <- RunPCA(seurat_mg) %>%
        RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)

########################################################################################################################
# I tried subsetting all microglai and running diffusion map and calculating dpt on this.
# Unfortunately this seemed to confuse the algorhith amd I would get opposite directions to what is known from the data and between the samples. 
# If I run it separately on both samples, the problem is not present.
# Update as of 24/10/2022: maybe the different directions is not a problem. I now rather think that this shows that the two trajectories are differing majorly and running diffusion map on them all togther it is the best way to comapre them.
########################################################################################################################

# Subset all microglia without day 58
seurat_mg_no_d58 <- subset(seurat, subset = sample %in% c("MG-d3-ctrl", "MG-d15-ctrl", "MG-d30-ctrl", "MG-d3-cocul", "MG-d15-cocul", "MG-d30-cocul")) %>%
        subset(subset = celltype %in% c("remodelling microglia", "inflammatory microglia", "resting microglia", "lipid associated microglia", "proliferating microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)
VariableFeatures(seurat_mg_no_d58) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat_mg_no_d58), unlist(cc.genes))
seurat_mg_no_d58 <- CellCycleScoring(seurat_mg_no_d58,
                                  s.features = cc.genes$s.genes,
                                  g2m.features = cc.genes$g2m.genes,
                                  set.ident = TRUE)
seurat_mg_no_d58 <- ScaleData(seurat_mg_no_d58, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
seurat_mg_no_d58 <- RunPCA(seurat_mg_no_d58) %>%
        RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)
```

#### Seurat-based label transfer
```{r Seurat-based label transfer}

# Perform Seurat label transfer for projection of the reference onto the query (iPSC-dervied) microglia
# Find anchors
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = seurat_MG, query = seurat, dims = 1:50, npcs = 50, reduction = "rpca", k.filter = NA,verbose = F)
# Transfer the categorical information across the two datasets as predict.id
# Seurat does not correct or modify the query expression data
# Label transfer based on timepoint
predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, query = seurat, refdata = as.character(seurat_MG$timepoint_wks), dims = 1:50, weight.reduction = "pca") # project the PCA structure of the reference onto the query by default (this can be changed with the weight.reduction parameter). TransferData returns a matrix with predicted IDs and prediction scores, which we can add to the query metadata.
seurat$timepoint_wks_transfer <- predictions$predicted.id

# Label transfer based on cell type
predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, query = seurat, refdata = as.character(seurat_MG$celltype), dims = 1:50, weight.reduction = "pca")
seurat$celltype_transfer <- predictions$predicted.id

# Order metadata levels
levels_primary_wks <- factor(c(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 18))
seurat$timepoint_wks_transfer <- factor(seurat$timepoint_wks_transfer, levels = levels_primary_wks)

# Plot the label transfer by timepoint
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/transfer_kracht_by_week.pdf",  width = 6, height = 5)
DimPlot(seurat, group.by="timepoint_wks_transfer", reduction="umap_css", pt.size = 0.6, cols = vintage_rich_cols(11)) & NoAxes()
dev.off()
```

```{r similarity spectrum to reference}
# Calculate Reference Similarity Spectrum (RSS), given expression of the data and expression of the meta niches of the primary fetal microglia
sim2_MG_niches <- ref_sim_spectrum(seurat@assays$RNA@data, avg_expr_niches[vargenes_niches,], scale=F)
dimnames(sim2_MG_niches) <- list(colnames(seurat), colnames(avg_expr_niches))
cols_MG_ct <- setNames(c("#A569BD","#E59866","#E74C3C","#F4D03F","#82E0AA","#5DADE2","#52BE80","#27AE60","#48C9B0","#17A589"), levels(meta_niches$celltype))

# plot similarity to the primary microglia similarity spectrum score
png("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/css_similarity_to_primary_umap.png", width = 2200, height = 1900, res = 400)
par(mar=c(1,1,1,1)); plotFeature(Embeddings(seurat,"umap_css"), apply(sim2_MG_niches,1,max), colorPal=bluered_colscheme, cex=0.4, pt_border=F, do_legend = T, legend_cex = 0.2, legend_pos = "bottomleft")
dev.off
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/css_similarity_to_primary_umap.pdf", width = 4.5, height = 4)
par(mar=c(1,1,1,1)); plotFeature(Embeddings(seurat,"umap_css"), apply(sim2_MG_niches,1,max), colorPal=bluered_colscheme, cex=0.4, pt_border=F, do_legend = T, legend_cex = 0.2, legend_pos = "bottomleft")
dev.off
# max sim 0.7971078
# min sim  -0.0248003

library("vioplot")
# plot the similarity to primary microglia as a score as a boxplot
idx_MG <- which(!seurat@active.ident %in% as.character(6:9))
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/css_similarity_to_primary_boxplot.pdf", width = 7, height = 4)
par(mar=c(10,5,1,1)); boxplot(tapply(apply(sim2_MG_niches,1,max)[idx_MG], seurat$sample[idx_MG], list), las=2, frame=F, pch=21, cex.axis=0.8, ylab="max(R)", cex.lab=1.3, col = col_sample, outcex = 0.2)
dev.off()
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/css_similarity_to_primary_vlnplot.pdf", width = 7, height = 4)
par(mar=c(10,5,1,1)); vioplot(tapply(apply(sim2_MG_niches,1,max)[idx_MG], seurat$sample[idx_MG], list), las=2, frame=F, pch=19, cex.axis=0.8, ylab="max(R)", cex.lab=1.3, col = col_sample)
dev.off()

avg_expr_highres <- sapply(levels(seurat$RNA_snn_res.10), function(cl) rowMeans(seurat@assays$RNA@data[,which(seurat$RNA_snn_res.10==cl)]))
sim2_highres <- ref_sim_spectrum(seurat@assays$RNA@data, avg_expr_highres[intersect(vargenes_niches,rownames(avg_expr_highres)),], scale=F)
summary(apply(sim2_highres,1,max)[idx_MG])
```

#### Add am odule score for activation or homeostasis to in vitro microglia based on kracht culture
```{r module score}

top50_ct_markers_kracht <- read.csv("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Plots/Kracht_primary_microglia/top50_ct_markers_kracht_renamed_ct.csv")
activated <- top50_ct_markers_kracht %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  filter(cluster == "Activated microglia")
homeostatic_late <- top50_ct_markers_kracht %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  filter(cluster == "Homeostatic microglia (late)") %>% filter(gene != c("RNA5SP151"))

seurat <- AddModuleScore(object = seurat, features = activated$gene, ctrl = 50, name = 'activated') 
seurat <- AddModuleScore(object = seurat, features = homeostatic_late$gene, ctrl = 50, name = 'homeostatic_late')

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/dotpt_homeostatic_activated_score.pdf", width = 6, height =4)
```
